description: Work with nanobot from Linear issues through native Agent Sessions.
requirements: A private Linear OAuth app and a stable public HTTPS callback URL

setup.tryIt: Mention the app in an issue comment. Follow-ups inside its Agent Session do not need another mention.
setup.summary: Create a private Linear OAuth app, save its credentials and public URL, then authorize each workspace. New sessions require an explicit @mention; ordinary comments are ignored.
steps: Expose this nanobot instance through a stable HTTPS URL (a tunnel is fine).
Create a private OAuth app in Linear with read, write, and app:mentionable scopes. Do not add app:assignable.
Subscribe the app webhook to AgentSessionEvent, PermissionChange, and OAuthAuthorization using the generated webhook URL.
Save settings, connect the workspace with OAuth, then @mention the app on an issue.

clientId.label: OAuth client ID
clientId.help: Copy it from the private OAuth app in Linear.

clientSecret.label: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.help: Stored only by this nanobot instance.

webhookSigningSecret.label: Webhook signing secret
webhookSigningSecret.help: Used to verify Linear-Signature before any webhook body is parsed.

publicBaseUrl.label: Public HTTPS URL
publicBaseUrl.help: A stable HTTPS origin routed to the listener below; do not include a path.

allowFrom.label: Allowed Linear users
allowFrom.help: Leave empty to use nanobot pairing, or use * to allow every user in connected workspaces.

custom.authorizeDescription: Open Linear in this browser or scan the QR code. nanobot enables the channel after authorization.
